en.t: You can see the fork in the road from there, can't you?

units.source_text: 越过岔口去办事的时候，我经常盯着开往东京的列车。”

en.t: When I cross past the fork to run errands, I often stare at the trains bound for Tokyo.

units.source_text: 道子从高架桥上注视着远方，说。

en.t: Michiko said this while gazing into the distance from the overpass.
